simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to רֵחֶה (H7347) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: רֵחֶה (rêcheh) means a mill -stone First listed occurrence: Deut 24 6.

definitions.full: H7347. recheh [ רֵחַה ] noun [masculine] , only dual רֵחַיִם (hand-)mill (probably = two mill-stones ); — ׳ר absolute, common household utensil, turned by maids, Exod 11:5 ( הָרֵחָ֑יִלם ; J), female slaves Isa 47:1 (with טָחַן , q. v.); בָּר ׳טָחַן Num 11:8 (J); ׳ר וָרָ֑כֶב Deut 24:6 (see רכב ); ר ׳קוֺל as sound of family life Jer 25:10 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to pulverize ;
